## 1. Overview & Getting Compute Sanitizer

> "Compute Sanitizer is a functional correctness checking suite included in the CUDA toolkit."

> "Compute Sanitizer is installed as part of the CUDA toolkit."

**Tools provided:**
- **Memcheck** – memory access error and leak detection
- **Racecheck** – shared memory data access hazard detection
- **Initcheck** – uninitialized device global memory access detection
- **Synccheck** – thread synchronization hazard detection

**General invocation syntax:**
```
compute-sanitizer [options] app_name [app_options]
```

---

## 2. How to Run the Memcheck Tool

> "The memcheck tool is enabled by default when running the Compute Sanitizer application. It can also be explicitly enabled by using the `--tool memcheck` option."

```
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck [sanitizer_options] app_name [app_options]
```

> "When run in this way, the memcheck tool will look for precise, imprecise, malloc/free and CUDA API errors. The reporting of device leaks must be explicitly enabled."

**Other tools:**
```
compute-sanitizer --tool racecheck [sanitizer_options] app_name [app_options]
compute-sanitizer --tool initcheck [sanitizer_options] app_name [app_options]
compute-sanitizer --tool synccheck [sanitizer_options] app_name [app_options]
```

---

## 3. Getting Source Line Numbers (Compilation Flags)

### Key statement
> "The Compute Sanitizer tools do not need any special compilation flags to function."

### `-G` (device debug info)
> "The `-G` option to nvcc forces the compiler to generate debug information for the CUDA application."

### `-lineinfo`
> "To generate line number information for applications without affecting the optimization level of the output, the `-lineinfo` nvcc option can be used. The Compute Sanitizer tools fully support both of these options and can display source attribution of errors for applications compiled with line information."

### `-fdevice-sanitize=memcheck` (compile-time instrumentation, memcheck only)
> "For memcheck specifically, the `-fdevice-sanitize=memcheck` option enables compile-time instrumentation, which provides significant performance improvements and enhanced error detection through base-and-bounds analysis."

> **Note:** "Option `-fdevice-sanitize=memcheck` does not imply the generation of debug information. To get source attribution of errors, the application must also be compiled with `-lineinfo` or `-G`."

### Backtrace symbol flags
> "For the host backtrace, this varies based on the host OS. On Linux, the host compiler must be given the `-rdynamic` option to retain function symbols. On Windows, the application must be compiled for debugging, i.e. the `/Zi` option. When using nvcc, flags to the host compiler can be specified using the `-Xcompiler` option."

### Sample build commands
```
nvcc -Xcompiler -rdynamic -lineinfo  -o out in.cu
```
```
nvcc -fdevice-sanitize=memcheck -lineinfo -o out in.cu
```

# 用 compute-sanitizer（旧 cuda-memcheck）定位 CUDA 越界行

## 0. 先确定用哪个工具（版本决定）

官方 CUDA 12.0 Release Notes「1.3. Deprecated Features → CUDA Tools」原文：

> "CUDA-MEMCHECK is removed from CUDA 12.0, and has been replaced with Compute Sanitizer."

来源：https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/12.0.0/cuda-toolkit-release-notes/index.html

因此：
- **CUDA ≥ 12.0**：用 `compute-sanitizer`（`cuda-memcheck` 已从 Toolkit 移除）。
- **CUDA ≤ 11.x**：用 `cuda-memcheck`。
- compute-sanitizer 随 CUDA Toolkit 一起安装；官方用户指南原文："Compute Sanitizer is a functional correctness checking suite included in the CUDA toolkit."

---

## 1. 关键前提：编译时必须带行号信息

官方原文（用户指南 "Getting Started"）：
> "The Compute Sanitizer tools do not need any special compilation flags to function."
> "The `-G` option to nvcc forces the compiler to generate debug information..."
> "To generate line number information for applications without affecting the optimization level of the output, the `-lineinfo` nvcc option can be used. The Compute Sanitizer tools fully support both of these options and can display source attribution of errors for applications compiled with line information."

也就是说：**工具不强制重编译，但要输出 `文件:行号`，必须用 `-lineinfo`（推荐，不破坏优化）或 `-G`（完整设备调试信息，较慢）。** 不加则只有 `kernel()+偏移`，看不到源码行。

```bash
# 推荐：保留优化 + 行号
nvcc -lineinfo -o app app.cu

# 需要函数名/断点调试时用 -G
nvcc -G -g -o app app.cu

# 需要主机侧调用栈符号（Linux）
nvcc -Xcompiler -rdynamic -lineinfo -o app app.cu
```

C++ 文件名可读性（还原模板/mangle 名）默认已开启：`--demangle` 默认值为 `full`。

---

## 2. 运行 memcheck

```bash
# memcheck 是默认工具，可省略 --tool memcheck
compute-sanitizer ./app

# 显式指定
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck ./app arg1 arg2
```

官方原文："The memcheck tool is enabled by default when running the Compute Sanitizer application. It can also be explicitly enabled by using the `--tool memcheck` option."
> "the memcheck tool will look for precise, imprecise, malloc/free and CUDA API errors."

---

## 3. 输出怎么读（定位到行）

官方给出的精确错误格式示例（用户指南 "Interpreting Memcheck Errors"）：

```
========= Invalid __global__ write of size 4 bytes
=========     at unaligned_kernel():0x160 in memcheck_demo.cu:6
=========     by thread (0,0,0) in block (0,0,0)
=========     Address 0x7f6510c00001 is misaligned
```

官方逐行解释：
- 第1行：内存段（`__global__` / `__shared__` / `__local__`）+ 读/写 + 字节数。
- **第2行：kernel 名 + 指令偏移 + `<源文件>:<行号>`（行号来自 `-lineinfo`/`-G`）← 这就是你要找的越界行**。
- 第3行：thread/block 索引（哪条线程越界）。
- 第4行：地址与被访问类型（"out of bounds" 或 "misaligned"）。

越界错误文本形如 `Invalid __global__ load of size N bytes ... is out of bounds`，配合上方 thread/block 即可定位越界发生的源码行与线程坐标。

来源：https://docs.nvidia.com/compute-sanitizer/ComputeSanitizer/index.html

---

## 4. 常用参数（官方参数表摘录）

通用：
| 参数 | 取值 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--tool` | memcheck, racecheck, initcheck, synccheck | memcheck | 选择工具 |
| `--print-limit` | 数字 | 100 | 超过 N 条错误停止打印（0=不限） |
| `--launch-timeout` | 秒 | 10（单进程）/60（多进程） | 连接目标进程超时，0=无限 |
| `--log-file` | 文件名 | — | 全部输出写入文件（默认 stdout） |
| `--demangle` | full, simple, no | full | C++ 符号还原 |
| `--kernel-name` | e.g. `kns=substring` | — | 只检查匹配的 kernel |
| `--kernel-name-exclude` | e.g. `kns=delta` | — | 排除 kernel |
| `--launch-skip` | 数字 | 0 | 跳过前 N 次 launch |
| `--launch-count` | 数字 | 0 | 只检查 N 次 launch |
| `--target-processes` | application-only, all | all | 是否跟踪子进程 |
| `--destroy-on-device-error` | context, kernel | context | 出错后销毁上下文还是仅终止 kernel（设为 kernel 可继续跑出更多错误） |
| `--error-exitcode` | 数字 | 0 | 检出错误但程序正常退出时返回的码 |

backtrace：`--show-backtrace`（yes/host/device/no，默认 yes）、`--backtrace-short`（默认 yes）。

memcheck 专有：`--report-api-errors`（all/extended/explicit/no，默认 extended）、`--leak-check full|no`、`--padding N`、`--check-cache-control`。

较新版本还有**编译期插桩**，性能更好、检测更强：
```bash
nvcc -fdevice-sanitize=memcheck -lineinfo -o app app.cu
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck ./app
```
官方注意："Option `-fdevice-sanitize=memcheck` does not imply the generation of debug information. To get source attribution of errors, the application must also be compiled with `-lineinfo` or `-G`."

常用组合示例：
```bash
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck --launch-timeout 120 --print-limit 20 \
  --demangle full --log-file sanitizer.log ./app
# 出错后继续跑其它 kernel，多抓错误：
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck --destroy-on-device-error kernel ./app
```

## 5. 旧 cuda-memcheck 等价写法（CUDA ≤ 11.x）

```bash
cuda-memcheck --tool memcheck --show-backtrace yes ./app

# 输出到文件
cuda-memcheck --tool memcheck --log-file out.txt ./app
```
同样需用 `nvcc -lineinfo` 编译才有 `file:line`；输出前缀 `=========`、字段格式与上面一致（cuda-memcheck 选项与 compute-sanitizer 同源，`-s`/`--launch-skip`、`--print-limit` 等沿用）。

来源（第三方交叉印证，非官方）：知乎文称 cuda-memcheck 自 CUDA 12.0 起从 Toolkit 移除；GitHub issue 提到 12.5 已废弃。后者与官方 12.0 移除说法不一致，以官方 Release Notes 为准。

---

## 6. 实践要点 / 常见坑

1. **必须 `-lineinfo` 或 `-G`**，否则只有 `kernel+0xNNN`，无法定位源码行。
2. 越界可能发生在**越界写导致后续 kernel 才报错**；用 `--destroy-on-device-error kernel` + `--print-limit` 多抓几条。
3. 只想查某个 kernel：`--kernel-name kns=MyKernel`；只查某次迭代：`--launch-skip`/`--launch-count`。
4. `--padding N` 可在每次 cudaMalloc 后加填充，捕捉越过分配末尾却落入相邻分配的越界。
5. 定位不到但确实报错时，可用 `--generate-coredump`（CUDA 11.6+）生成 coredump，配合 cuda-gdb 分析。
6. 官方注意："The PTX compiler and compute-sanitizer must be from the same CUDA toolkit version for compile-time patching with memcheck."（编译期插桩要求 PTX 编译器与 compute-sanitizer 同属一个 CUDA Toolkit 版本）。

| `--kernel-name` | e.g. `kns=substring` | — | 只检查匹配的 kernel |
| `--kernel-name-exclude` | e.g. `kns=delta` | — | 排除 kernel |
| `--launch-skip` | 数字 | 0 | 跳过前 N 次 launch |
| `--launch-count` | 数字 | 0 | 只检查 N 次 launch |
| `--target-processes` | application-only, all | all | 是否跟踪子进程 |
| `--destroy-on-device-error` | context, kernel | context | 出错后销毁上下文还是仅终止 kernel（设为 kernel 可继续跑出更多错误） |
| `--error-exitcode` | 数字 | 0 | 检出错误但程序正常退出时返回的码 |

backtrace：`--show-backtrace`（yes/host/device/no，默认 yes）、`--backtrace-short`（默认 yes）。

memcheck 专有：`--report-api-errors`（all/extended/explicit/no，默认 extended）、`--leak-check full|no`、`--padding N`、`--check-cache-control`。

较新版本还有**编译期插桩**，性能更好、检测更强：
```bash
nvcc -fdevice-sanitize=memcheck -lineinfo -o app app.cu
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck ./app
```
官方注意："Option `-fdevice-sanitize=memcheck` does not imply the generation of debug information. To get source attribution of errors, the application must also be compiled with `-lineinfo` or `-G`."

常用组合示例：
```bash
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck --launch-timeout 120 --print-limit 20 \
  --demangle full --log-file sanitizer.log ./app
# 出错后继续跑其它 kernel，多抓错误：
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck --destroy-on-device-error kernel ./app
```

## 5. 旧 cuda-memcheck 等价写法（CUDA ≤ 11.x）

```bash
cuda-memcheck --tool memcheck --show-backtrace yes ./app

# 输出到文件
cuda-memcheck --tool memcheck --log-file out.txt ./app
```
同样需用 `nvcc -lineinfo` 编译才有 `file:line`；输出前缀 `=========`、字段格式与上面一致（cuda-memcheck 选项与 compute-sanitizer 同源，`-s`/`--launch-skip`、`--print-limit` 等沿用）。

来源（第三方交叉印证，非官方）：知乎文称 cuda-memcheck 自 CUDA 12.0 起从 Toolkit 移除；GitHub issue 提到 12.5 已废弃。后者与官方 12.0 移除说法不一致，以官方 Release Notes 为准。

## 6. 实践要点 / 常见坑

1. **必须 `-lineinfo` 或 `-G`**，否则只有 `kernel+0xNNN`，无法定位源码行。
2. 越界可能发生在**越界写导致后续 kernel 才报错**；用 `--destroy-on-device-error kernel` + `--print-limit` 多抓几条。
3. 只想查某个 kernel：`--kernel-name kns=MyKernel`；只查某次迭代：`--launch-skip`/`--launch-count`。
4. `--padding N` 可在每次 cudaMalloc 后加填充，捕捉越过分配末尾却落入相邻分配的越界。
5. 定位不到但确实报错时，可用 `--generate-coredump`（CUDA 11.6+）生成 coredump，配合 cuda-gdb 分析。
6. 官方注意："The PTX compiler and compute-sanitizer must be from the same CUDA toolkit version for compile-time patching with memcheck."（编译期插桩要求 PTX 编译器与 compute-sanitizer 同属一个 CUDA Toolkit 版本）。
